card.name: Adjectives before a noun in formal text
card.fires_on: An adjective or adjective-like word that modifies a following noun, in policy, science or technical prose. Examples are 'tropical' before 'zone', 'disciplinary' before 'practice', and 'supply' before 'voltages'.

modes.label: Modifier before a noun
modes.description: A descriptive adjective or noun modifier that leads into a noun phrase, such as zone, treatment or voltages.
modes.example: along the boundary of the south<< tropical>> zone.

modes.label: Partway through an adjective
modes.description: The middle or end of a long adjective whose next word is a noun in an official name.

card.plain: It fires on a describing word that is waiting for the noun it modifies, mostly in formal policy or technical writing.
